comment: The store builds of the extension that a release host lets in. chrome_web_store and edge_add_ons hold chrome-extension://<32-letter id>/ with the trailing slash; Brave installs from the Chrome Web Store and reads Chrome's registry key, so it has no list of its own. firefox_add_ons holds the Firefox Add-ons id, fixed by the extension's browser_specific_settings.gecko.id. While all three lists are empty, build-release-local.ps1 ships the app without the host; any one of them ships it, and the installer registers only the browsers whose list has an id. It refuses a list holding the development id from allowed-origins.dev.json or a malformed entry, and the host's --check-release refuses a host with no store id.
